captureBasis: Current graph and superseding decomposition decision captured from the rebased implementation-start commit; this document commit does not claim to be its own future commit SHA.

currentCompileBoundary.description: The generated target-membership inventory records 1,330 Swift files in Ambitions and seven Core/Time pilot files only in AmbitionsTimeFoundation; most canonical folders remain outside compiler-enforced feature/runtime modules.

pilotBoundary.publicApiDelta: The seven formerly app-internal time files now expose the declarations required by app and test consumers across the framework boundary; this is a reviewed pilot API surface, not authorization for another extraction.

domainCompilerBlocker.claimBoundary: The compiler blocker is current failed-boundary evidence and the 45-file lexical estimate is triage evidence only; neither authorizes an AmbitionsDomain target.

decompositionPolicy.futureCandidateRequirements: All prospective status, evidence, and numeric authorization requirements are owned exclusively by docs/qa/architecture/module-candidate-policy.json and evaluated by scripts/ambitions-module-candidate-gate.py.
decompositionPolicy.authorizationEvidenceModel: Pointer-only candidate rows reference typed JSON artifacts that remain untrusted inputs. On a clean tracked worktree, the default provider runs XcodeGen with environment expansion disabled, requires the proposed target to be a framework, derives every target product type and graph role, generates ephemeral source-truth PBX evidence, and compares its complete nodes, edges, product types, and source memberships with the ignored/untracked current generated Ambitions.xcodeproj derivative. It also re-plans each source through the live changed-file router including suite validation. Compiler/symbolgraph, xcresult, benchmark, and external-review conclusions remain observed unless a caller-controlled trusted provider rederives them; the provider execution environment is an external trust precondition.
decompositionPolicy.authorizationReviewBinding: Artifact fingerprints and distinct reviewer strings preserve integrity metadata but do not establish external review trust. Repository Git authorship, unsigned notes, and artifact allowlists cannot authorize a candidate. The CLI/default provider has no external review attestation authority, so every current candidate remains observed or rejected and zero future targets are authorized.
decompositionPolicy.futureTargetTree: none predetermined; only a policy-authorized explicit source cohort may justify a proposed target
decompositionPolicy.coldBuildSeparation: The 439-second cache-invalidated build is a separate optimization from the verified 8-second warm build and 21.262-second health-selected hosted focused test.

assessment.reason: The seven-file TimeFoundation pilot and its module tests are compiler-enforced and acyclic, and the warm focused loop is within its provisional target on the configured healthy simulator. Broader decomposition remains unimplemented; whole-folder Domain extraction is superseded as a speed prerequisite, the cache-invalidated app build remains expensive, and extension targets still compile selected app source files directly.
